sloka: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा मैथिली भर्तृदेवता ।भर्तृभक्तिव्रता साध्वी तथेति प्रत्यभाषत ।। ६.११७.१२ ।।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā maithilī bhartṛdevatā ।bhartṛbhaktivratā sādhvī tatheti pratyabhāṣata ।। 6.117.12 ।।

translations.english: Hearing Sita's words Vibheeshana replied saying," You will and ought to do what your husband Rama has said."
